name: Performance Engineering Audit & Design

performance_evidence_table.impact: First client request requiring embeddings absorbs model loading delay (~73s documented on CPU container)
pgvector distance queries <=> perform unindexed Seq Scan across tenant rows; runtime EXPLAIN unmeasured

performance_evidence_table.finding: Celery Solo Worker Strict Task Serialization
performance_evidence_table.impact: --pool=solo --concurrency=1 serializes PDF ingestion to one task at a time; worker thread blocks on Gemini network I/O

performance_evidence_table.finding: Theoretical Connection Capacity Exceeds Postgres Default
performance_evidence_table.impact: Configuration-based risk (80 base / 140 HPA max connections vs 100 Postgres default); no observed runtime exhaustion

performance_evidence_table.finding: N+1 Criteria Query Pattern in Candidate Retrieval
performance_evidence_table.impact: Code path executes sequential list_by_trial queries in a loop; exact runtime latency unmeasured

performance_evidence_table.finding: Unbatched Criteria Embedding and DB Flush Loops
performance_evidence_table.impact: Code path executes single-text embeddings and single-row flushes in a loop; exact runtime latency unmeasured

performance_evidence_table.finding: RWO Upload PVC Constrains Multi-Node Worker Scale
performance_evidence_table.impact: ReadWriteOnce local-path volume binds worker replicas via podAffinity to the single node hosting ai-service
Queries ordering by created_at DESC or filtering by action trigger full table scans as logs accumulate

performance_evidence_table.finding: Celery Broker and App Cache Share Redis DB 0
performance_evidence_table.impact: Shared database poses key namespace and memory eviction risks under heavy caching

performance_evidence_table.finding: Gemini Latency Dominates Total Request Latency
performance_evidence_table.impact: Estimated ~1.5s-6.0s matching latency and ~3s-12s extraction latency based on SaaS roundtrips; unmeasured in repo

1_pgvector_sequential_scan.summary: No HNSW/IVFFlat index exists in production migrations; pgvector <=> queries perform Seq Scan. Runtime EXPLAIN is unmeasured.

2_hnsw_absence_reason.summary: HNSW was evaluated in research phase E4 (reproducibility_specification.md) but was never applied to production schema migrations.

3_top_k_constrains_work.summary: Does not constrain the vector distance computation across tenant rows, but strictly limits downstream criteria queries, prompt token size, and Gemini reasoning duration.

4_solo_worker_serializes_work.summary: --pool=solo --concurrency=1 forces all ingestion tasks to execute sequentially in a single process.

5_gemini_dominates_matching_latency.summary: Estimated to represent 90% to 98% of total response latency on cache miss based on typical SaaS roundtrips; empirical latency histograms are unmeasured.

6_gemini_dominates_ingestion_latency.summary: Protocol extraction via Gemini is estimated to represent 65% to 85% of total task duration; empirical latency histograms are unmeasured.

7_embedding_cpu_bottleneck.summary: SentenceTransformer runs CPU inference within tight cgroup limits (1 core in AI, 0.5 core in worker), causing CFS throttling under concurrency.

8_rwo_limits_worker_scaling.summary: ReadWriteOnce local-path volume binds worker replicas to the single node hosting ai-service via podAffinity.

9_connection_pool_bottleneck.summary: Configured client pool capacity (80 base / 140 HPA) exceeds default PostgreSQL max_connections (100). No runtime connection exhaustion has been observed.

10_n_plus_one_queries.summary: Code-path verified N+1 in MatchingService criteria retrieval and repeated sequential flushes in trial ingestion; exact runtime latency impact is unmeasured.

benchmark_gap_phase14_1_requirements: Embedding model P50/P95/P99 latency for single text and batch sizes (1, 4, 8, 16, 32)
Retrieval P50/P95/P99 query latency across corpora (100, 1k, 10k, 50k trials) with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)
Gemini API P50/P95/P99 roundtrip latency and token throughput distributions
End-to-end matching evaluation P50/P95/P99 under cold and warm cache at concurrency 1, 5, 10, 25
Trial ingestion duration and stage breakdown profiling on standardized protocol PDFs
Celery queue wait time, execution duration, and throughput under concurrent uploads
CPU utilization and CFS throttling tracking against Kubernetes cgroup limits
Peak RSS memory profiling to assess OOM risk against 1Gi limits
Database connection pool active vs idle connection utilization under load

candidate_optimization_hypotheses.expected_mechanism: Eliminate cold-start latency spike on first client request by initializing SentenceTransformer during lifespan
Reduce criteria database round-trips from N to 1 using WHERE trial_id IN (...)

candidate_optimization_hypotheses.hypothesis: Hypothesis 3 — Bulk Persistence for Ingested Criteria (PERF-06)
candidate_optimization_hypotheses.expected_mechanism: Reduce database round-trips during PDF ingestion from M to 1 by batching criteria embeddings
Prevent sequential table scans on audit_logs(created_at, action) via b-tree indexes
Bound peak connections per AI pod to 10 (pool_size=5, max_overflow=5) to prevent connection exhaustion

explicitly_deferred_items: HNSW vector index migration (requires clinical recall benchmarking)
Object storage migration for uploads (requires architectural change)
